body.x: IBM participated in ‘CES 2018Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced Watson, an artificial intelligence.

IBM displayed story wall of Watson, an artificial intelligence in the exhibition hall, which attracted the attention of visitors. API(Application Programming Interface) development program was used to Watson, which has 15 languages and six areas. Companies and developers can create and commercialize various applications using them.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
